release_commit_note: The release commit is recorded by Git history; embedding the containing commit would create a self-referential hash.
summary: Four user-requested minor UI/UX fixes. (1) The state header strip now shows a News field with the total related-news item count for the state. (2) The dense, unbroken 'Prepared for / Research date / Version / Model checkpoint / Interpretation scope / Scope note' intro paragraph -- present in every state's markdown -- is now rendered as a readable .doc-meta-box label/value list by a new buildDocMetaBox() function in docs/app.js, driven by the fixed label set so it applies to all 50 states without per-file edits. (3) The redundant 'Each authority below is presented as...' boilerplate paragraph was removed from the 29 state markdown files that had it. (4) The 'Process note (Agent Instructions Amendment 5...)' blockquote in those same 29 files was shortened to a single-sentence status line. agents/roles/web-ux-ui-editor.md bumped to 1.5.0.
